# RASTER CSS

> The Refined Neo-Swiss Editorial Design System for Humans & AI Agents.
> Whisper-quiet monochrome, sentence-case Grotesque typography, 1px hairline specification rows, and zero generic AI slop.

## Overview
Raster CSS is a framework-agnostic CSS design system inspired by contemporary Swiss editorial minimalism (Motus, Dieter Rams, Vitsoe, International Typographic Style). It works seamlessly across React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, Astro, and plain HTML.

## Key Links
- [AI Agent Codex & Strict Rules](AI.md): Complete machine-readable instructions, rules, anti-patterns, and component blueprints.
- [Main Bundle](dist/raster.css): Consolidated single-file distribution.
- [Design Tokens](src/css/tokens.css): CSS variables for Light & Dark mode, colors, typography, spacing.
- [Typography](src/css/typography.css): Calm sentence-case display scales, muted specification keys, tabular numerals.
- [Grid System](src/css/grid.css): Sticky 4:8 split layouts (`.raster-split-sticky`), tight 8px mosaics (`.raster-mosaic`), and 12-column grids.
- [Components](src/css/components.css): Hairline spec rows (`.raster-spec-row`), borderless studio surface cards (`.raster-surface-card`), steppers, floating scroll bars, ledgers, and 3-zone footers.

## The Refined Neo-Swiss Rules
- NO neon glows, glowing shadows, or purple radial gradients.
- NO 9999px pills or mushy 16-24px rounded corners (All corners are 0px).
- NO heavy brutalist borders or shouty all-caps headers.
- Whisper-quiet monochrome palette: `#FFFFFF` canvas + `#F4F4F4` studio gray wells + `#111111` ink (Light) and `#0A0A0A` + `#151515` + `#F5F5F5` (Dark).
- Calm sentence-case Grotesque headings (`font-weight: 400`, `-0.03em` tracking) paired with `11px` sentence-case muted specification keys (`#767676`).
- Whisper-thin `1px solid` horizontal hairlines separating key-value specification rows.
- ZERO SELF-BRANDING: NEVER write "Raster CSS" or "Raster" on project HTML/UI. Output strictly the user's project brand.

## Minimal Setup
```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="dist/raster.css">
```

## Theme Switching
Add `data-theme="dark"` or `data-theme="light"` to the `<html>` or container tag.
